gloss: to paste, to stick, to affix

definitions.gloss: to paste, to stick, to affix, to apply
definitions.explanation: To attach something to a surface using adhesive, glue, or similar means.

examples.japanese: ポスターを{壁|かべ}に{貼|は}る。
examples.english: To put up a poster on the wall.

examples.japanese: {切手|きって}を{封筒|ふうとう}に{貼|は}った。
examples.english: I stuck a stamp on the envelope.

examples.japanese: {全|ぜん}ページにシールを{貼|は}った。
examples.english: I put stickers on every page.

notes:
{貼|は}る specifically means to stick/paste something onto a surface.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜を…に{貼|は}る (to stick ~ onto …)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シールを{貼|は}る: to put on a sticker
- ポスターを{貼|は}る: to put up a poster
- {切手|きって}を{貼|は}る: to affix a stamp
- {湿布|しっぷ}を{貼|は}る: to apply a compress
- テープを{貼|は}る: to put on tape

NOTE:
{貼|は}る (to stick) and {張|は}る (to stretch, to put up) are different kanji. {貼|は}る focuses on adhesion.
